items.title: What Is the Bias–Variance Tradeoff? Underfitting and Overfitting Explained
items.summary: The bias-variance tradeoff describes tension between models that are too rigid to capture real structure and models that react too strongly to the particular training sample. This guide explains the mechanism, trade-offs, evaluation, and controls that matter in practice.

items.title: Robot Talk Episode 165 – Robots behind the research, with Kushant Patel
items.summary: Claire chatted to Kushant Patel from Brookhaven National Laboratory about robots that work in scientific facilities, such as particle accelerators. Kushant Patel builds software that helps robots and instruments perceive, map, and move through the physical world. After completing a Master’s in Mechatronics Engineering at the University of Waterloo, he spent two years at the University of California, Berkeley teaching quadruped robots to map and inspect nuclear material, and a year at the University of California, Davis building closed-loop brain-computer interfaces. At Brookhaven National Laboratory, he is developing control systems for advanced synchrotron beamlines.
